user_request: Same rolling+ATC with and without learned selector; same routing/waits/CPU3; no deadline protection; 85% energy/temperature/on-time.
primary: ROLLING_COST: minimize common predicted energy/heat/per-class-delay/unfinished objective over all same legal actions, tie by descending public ATC feature then ordinal then index. No neural weights, no teacher, no learning.
secondary: TEACHER_RULE: execute the exact causal route-preference/EDF/event-wait teacher used for BC, as a strong nonlearning control. It receives/computes the same rolling bank; it can ignore score inputs just as a neural selector can. No neural weights or RL history.
RL: Frozen three existing checkpoints881081/881083/881087; greedy NN logits on the exact same bank; no updates or weight selection on these new inputs. Previously DEV-selected runtime representative881087 remains fixed.

shared_scores.class_normalization: Use causal recent64 observed task mix, defaultC75 before16 observations; clamp each class fraction to1/64. No actual future arrival/workload ratio/latent durations provided.
shared_scores.origin: Energy/heat scales and .98 delay coefficients frozen from prior TRAIN, before new EVAL. Same scores provided to every selector; NN.choose uses x/mask only. No EVAL tuning.
shared_scores.tie: Absolute score tolerance1e-12, highest clipped public ATC feature11, lower ordinal, lower bank index; no deadline feasibility filtering.

evaluation.order: Rotate the five policies by case index, fixed before execution. All pairing uses same arrivals/context/stream and identical observer/physics/rollouts/actions; host runtime is not simulated device time.
metrics: total API-J including whole observation baseline

physical_accuracy_gate: FAIL preserved; no k scaling, CPU3 extra-core calibration, artificial temperature clip or invented throttling.
preflight: Saved TRAIN snapshots only; compare every common bank x/mask/actions/forecasts to original module on identical public states; independent rule ties and perturb illegal-action tests; no new plant runs.
acceptance: Report every result including deadline losses/unfinished. RL whole-method advantage and reward-learning-only causal attribution are separate. No method/weight/seed selected after new EVAL. Secondary teacher has no inherited RL weights; frozen BC would inherit them and is not a no-RL control.
